description: Ministry of Youth and Sports - Regulation made by the Minister of Youth and Sports under Section 41 read with Section 31 of the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973
categorisation: This gazette content consists of regulations made by the Minister of Youth and Sports under the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973. It contains legal amendments to existing regulations (The National Associations of Sports Regulations, No. 01 of 2016) and establishes procedures for appeals and committee structures. While it mentions a specific minister (Namal Rajapaksa), this is in the context of his regulatory authority rather than detailing his portfolio responsibilities or being primarily about his appointment. The core content is legal/regulatory in nature, focusing on the establishment of legal frameworks and procedures under existing legislation.
